## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1 (pre-implementation): Write the failing pytest test that will validate runner behavior after T2 implements the package.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh completes (RED marker exempts smoke test failure)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py exists with test_runner_produces_findings_json
  Verify: test -f tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py && grep -q "def test_runner_produces_findings_json" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py
- [ ] .test-index has mapping for runner.py -> test_runner_smoke.py
  Verify: grep 'test_runner_smoke' .test-index
- [ ] tests/fixtures/ci-review-corpus/fixture-diff.txt exists and is non-empty
  Verify: test -s tests/fixtures/ci-review-corpus/fixture-diff.txt

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
